# MVPの範囲と優先順位

## 比べ方

各項目を1から5で評価し、理由となる情報を残します。評価の重みは結果を見る前に決めます。

| Factor | Weight | Scoring guidance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| User and business value | 30% | Contribution to success KPIs |
| Risk reduction and learning | 20% | Validates critical assumptions |
| Implementation effort | 20% | Lower effort receives a higher score |
| Operational cost | 15% | Lower recurring burden receives a higher score |
| Dependency readiness | 15% | Inputs and enabling capabilities are available |

## 完了チェック

- [ ] Scoring criteria and weights were agreed before scoring.
- [ ] Every inclusion and exclusion has an evidence-based rationale.
- [ ] MVP is the smallest coherent outcome, not a list of disconnected features.
- [ ] Critical assumptions have early validation activities.
